visits.title: Visits
visits.subtitle: Track customer site visits by date range and device type.
visits.empty: No visits match the current filters.

welcomeSubtitle: Here's what's happening at Dalloyou today
deleteError: Could not delete. It may still have linked products.
saveError: Failed to save. Please try again.

form.productFormIntro: Work from top to bottom: choose the category, add the customer-facing name and description, upload the product photo, pick a fixed size or a weight label, then set the price and any discount.
form.categoryHelper: Products appear under this category on the public menu.
form.nameEnHelper: Shown when the site language is English.
form.nameArHelper: Shown when the site language is Arabic.
form.displayImageHint: Square 1:1 photo (the same one used on the delivery apps). Shown on menu cards, the homepage showcase and the product page. Compressed automatically before upload.
form.measurementTypeHelper: You can leave it blank, choose a fixed size, or write the weight exactly as customers should see it.
form.measurementNoneHelper: No size or weight will appear on the product card or detail page.
form.weightLabelHelper: Write it as it should appear, for example: half kilo, 1 kilo, 1.25 kg.
form.productSizeHelper: Create a separate product for each size. Names may repeat.
form.variantAvailableHelper: Turn off only when this size should not be orderable.
form.isNewHelper: Appears in the 'New Arrivals' section on the homepage
form.dragDrop: Drag & drop an image, or click to browse
form.imageFormats: PNG or JPG · 1000×1000 px or larger
form.atLeastOneSize: Add at least one size below so customers can order this product.
form.imageTooSmall: ⚠ Image is smaller than 1000×1000 px — consider a higher-resolution file.
form.sizeEnabledHelper: Fill in price and photo for this size.
form.sizeDisabledHelper: Enable this size if customers can order it.
form.sectionBasicDesc: Name, category, and product details shown to customers.
form.sectionPricingDesc: Each product has one price. Choose a fixed size or write a weight label for this product.
form.sectionVisibilityDesc: Control where this product appears on the site.
form.descEnHelper: Appears on the product detail page. Keep it short and descriptive (1–3 sentences).
form.descArHelper: Arabic description — shown on the product page in Arabic.
form.basePriceHelper: The price before any discount. Required.
form.discountPriceHelper: Leave empty or 0 when the product is not discounted.
form.discountActive: {{percent}}% off — {{was}} SAR is shown struck through next to the new price.
form.discountTooHigh: The sale price must be lower than the price.
form.imageOptimised: ✓ Compressed to {{size}} (saved {{saved}}) for a faster upload.
form.uploadTimeout: The upload took too long and the connection dropped. The product may already be saved — check the product list before trying again.
form.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
form.imageTooLarge: The image is too large for the server. Try a smaller file.
form.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again, then save.
form.serverError: The server hit an error. Please try again in a moment.
form.variantSectionHelper: Add one variant per size if your product comes in multiple sizes. Each enabled variant needs its own price, availability, and photo.
form.variantImageHelper: Required. This image shows on product cards and the product detail page when this size is selected.
form.noVariantsAdded: No sizes added. Enable a size above to set its price.
form.isAvailableHelper: Show this product to customers. Turn off to hide without deleting.
form.isFeaturedHelper: Appears in the display window at the top of the homepage.
form.orderHelper: Lower numbers appear first. Leave at 0 for default ordering.

ipad.title: iPad menu
ipad.subtitle: The menu on the in-store iPads. Names, prices and availability come from the website products automatically, and every change here reaches all iPads within two minutes.

items.reorderHint: Drag products to reorder them within a category — the iPad shows the same order.
items.noCategories: Add a category first in the Categories tab.
items.notOnIpadTitle: Available on the website but not on the iPad
items.notOnIpadHint: Tap a product to add it.
items.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed from the iPad menu only — the website product is not affected.

badges.unavailable: Unavailable on the website — not shown

form.addTitle: Add a product to the iPad
form.productHelper: Name, price and availability come from the website. Edit the product on the Products page to change them.
form.linkedUnavailable: This product is unavailable on the website, so it won't show on the iPad until it becomes available.
form.priceHelper: Leave empty to show no price.
form.nameEnHelper: Shown under the Arabic name, on the iPad only.
form.sizeLabelHelper: Shown above the price on the detail screen, e.g. box, 24 pieces.
form.imageHint: Optional — without it the website photo is used.
form.imageHintTabletOnly: The product photo on the iPad.
form.detailImageHint: Shown next to the product photo on the detail screen, e.g. a cake cross-section.
form.visibleHelper: Turn off to hide the product from the iPad without deleting it.
form.nameRequired: Pick a website product or type the product name.
form.priceInvalid: The price must be a number.

categories.reorderHint: Drag categories to reorder the iPad tabs.
categories.deleteBody: The “{{name}}” category and its {{count}} products will be removed from the iPad menu. Website products are not affected.

gallery.visible: Show the custom designs page on the iPad
gallery.hint: Customers see the photos in a random order every time.
gallery.deleteBody: This photo will be removed from the custom designs page.

settings.idleSeconds: Back to the welcome screen after (seconds)
settings.idleSecondsHelper: When nobody touches the iPad for this long it returns to the welcome screen. Minimum 10 seconds.
settings.location: Text at the top of the menu
settings.syncNote: The iPads update themselves within two minutes — no need to reopen the menu.
